title: Import Contabilizei statement CSV
notes:
Implemented Contabilizei CSV import in worktree .worktrees/budget-budget-xlng (branch tk/budget-xlng), commit 08a3725.

New: parsers/sources/contabilizei.ts (zero-config source, mirrors nubank.ts). Payee <- Descricao, memo <- Lancamento, amounts <- Entrada/Saida (pt-BR, NBSP after R$ ok, bare '-' or empty = 0); both-empty or both-set rows -> line error. Derived import ids contabilizei:<date>:<signedMilli>:<n> (key: date + signed amount + lower-cased payee; ordinal 1-based per file). statement.ts routes it before the Nubank check (shared Data/Descricao header); generic parser untouched. i18n en + pt-BR: screen.subtitle and file.hint now list Contabilizei. useImportFlow passes importId through generically (makeDraftRows spreads rows, rowsToImport spreads, snakeImportRow sets wire.import_id) — no Nubank special case found, no flow change needed.

Checks in client/ (bun install shared-first done in worktree):
- bunx tsc --noEmit: exit 0
- bunx eslint .: exit 0 (i18n lint included)
- bun test: 1320 pass / 0 fail (99 files); import.test.ts: 43 pass / 0 fail, incl. 7 new tests: sample parse (BOM/CRLF/NBSP/'-' cells, 11 rows 0 errors, row1 YURI FREIRE LIMA/PIX/1000000 out, DARF Unificado 17831, NSX inflows 250000+7096041), unique+stable ids, :1/:2 for identical same-day rows, both-sides errors, detectContabilizeiCsv negative on Nubank/YNAB/generic fixtures, parseStatementFile routing (payee != PIX).

Plan's step 5 (manual dev-budget import + screenshots) left for review; tk finish intentionally not run.
Bug fix (plan's occurrence-key spec was wrong): payee removed from the occurrence key — ids now counted per (date, signedMilli), so same-day equal-amount rows with DIFFERENT payees get :1/:2 instead of colliding and being dropped by server dedupe. Commit <hash> on tk/budget-xlng; checks: tsc 0, eslint 0, bun test 1321 pass / 0 fail (8 Contabilizei tests incl. new cross-payee regression test). Plan file .agents/plans/2026-11-24_contabilizei-csv-import.md updated in main repo to match.
Correction to previous note: the fix commit hash is 14e6c57 (previous note had a placeholder). Full history on tk/budget-xlng: 08a3725 feat(client) import Contabilizei statement CSV, then 14e6c57 fix(client) Contabilizei import ids unique across payees.
Review follow-up applied, commit c080a0c on tk/budget-xlng: dropped the client-side importId entirely (occurrence map, ContabilizeiRow/ContabilizeiParseResult gone; plain ImportRow rows) — POST /bulk already generates YNAB:<milli>:<date>:<payeeId>:<occurrence> for id-less rows and dedupes against existing occurrences in the account, which is payee-aware and DB-anchored (robust across reordered overlapping exports where a file-order ordinal is not). Entrada/Saida cells are now netted (signed = inflow - outflow, split by sign): negative cells reverse their side, no negative cents. Net-zero rows -> 'amount is zero' (already mapped in parserMessages); both-sides-empty stays 'no readable amount'. Plan file in main repo corrected: the 'Not idempotent' finding retracted, design says no client id. Checks: tsc 0, eslint 0, bun test 1319 pass / 0 fail (6 Contabilizei tests incl. netting + net-zero + both-empty).
Orchestrator verification: c080a0c — tsc clean, import tests 94 pass/0 fail (omp: full client 1319 pass, eslint clean). Independent review findings (client id redundant with server YNAB fallback key; negative cells; zero-net message) addressed in c080a0c. Manual web check: 11 rows, correct payees, re-import adds 0 rows (evidence ev-4b0ece ev-2144f0 ev-c1e2d8 ev-330b2c). Server id-less dedupe covered by api/src/budget/routes/transactions.test.ts. Follow-ups: budget-otkr, budget-ujno.

Approved by user. Merged to main (3 commits: contabilizei.ts parser, statement.ts routing, i18n en/pt-BR; client sends no import id, server YNAB fallback dedupes re-imports).
